ModMetaData.name: Price Filter
ModMetaData.author: SHD2
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a "market value" filter next to the hit points and quality filters.
- Bills (cremation, butchering, smelting...): only take items whose unit market value is between X and Y. - Stockpiles and shelves: same filter. - Two-handle slider + exact min/max input (empty = no limit). - Value per unit (as shown in the info card), minified items included. - Saved with your game; removing the mod does not break saves. - Language option in mod settings (English by default, French available).
